label: 斧撃
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. FOUR-frame NORMAL ATTACK 斧撃 by 黒曜の処刑者 EXACT 2x2. Ordered: frame1 anticipation, frame2 held windup, frame3 powerful release, frame4 recovery. Trajectory: axe tip (260,660) pulls to (640,350), rises to (470,200), sweeps left-down to (160,760), returns (260,660). Both hands stay attached to the SAME haft. Exaggerated late-game weight and force, distinct readable poses, secondary cape/tail follows with lag. Body sheet only; tiny attached core/palm glow allowed, full attack VFX separate. Match the FIRST fixed canonical reference identity, palette, proportions, face, armor, weapons, wing/tail attachments and refined JRPG pixel art: crisp deliberate pixel clusters, stepped edges, dark outline, no airbrush or 3D render. LEFT-facing mild 3/4 view. All complete silhouettes have 12% clear margin in their own equal cells; no clipped tails, blades, wings, horns, fingers or feet. Same scale across every frame, true transparent alpha. No background, floor slab, shadow plate, labels, grid, checkerboard, text, watermark, extra creatures or detached body parts. Female characters remain clearly adults, dressed/armored as reference.  Each cell local 0..1024. Body root (540,550), head around (330,350) for bipeds or (300,520) for quadrupeds. Ground contacts y=850. Whole silhouette in x=100..920,y=120..880. Coordinates are movement targets, not evidence of output compliance.
reviewStatus: all source frames visually reviewed; playback and runtime acceptance pending

issues: 頭上の斧の刃が原画上端に接し、見切れの疑いがある。修正版では武器全体の余白を確保する。
発動の両刃斧が大きく、柄の長さ・手の位置・刃形がコマ間で変わる。固定武器として合わせる。
